anomaly_def.Name: Data Block and Index Integrity Anomaly
anomaly_def.Description: Definition: Root cause located in the persisted on-disk data and index structures, where physical pages, key ordering, page links, page checksums, or index-to-heap mappings have become inconsistent with the logical contents of the relations. It is independent of access-path or maintenance anomalies because the underlying structure itself is no longer trustworthy. Observable phenomena: index scans returning missing or duplicated rows, heap-scan counts diverging from index-scan counts, page-checksum or page-verification errors written to engine logs, integrity-verification utilities reporting key-order, leaf-row, or page-link errors, internal assertion failures, sudden plan fallback to full scans for previously index-served queries, and engine-reported physical or logical corruption errors. Possible contributing factors: storage subsystem faults or firmware defects, memory or processor bit flips not caught by error-correction mechanisms, power loss or ungraceful shutdown bypassing write-ahead semantics, engine defects in concurrency or recovery code paths, incomplete crash recovery, failed online index rebuilds, replication or materialized-view replay gaps, and version or storage-format mismatches after upgrades.

entry.official_definition: Specifies the amount of time with no network activity after which the operating system should send a TCP keepalive message to the client.
entry.trigger_condition: A TCP client connection has no network activity longer than tcp_keepalives_idle on systems supporting TCP_KEEPIDLE or an equivalent socket option.
entry.workload_impact: Starts TCP keepalive probing for an otherwise idle client connection; together with interval and count settings this can lead to dead connection detection.
entry.default_behavior: Default value is 0, selecting the operating system default.
entry.cause_analysis: This timeout is usually triggered when connection establishment, authentication exchange, or session activity does not progress within the allowed time budget.
entry.solution_guidance: Check connection lifecycle, client responsiveness, authentication latency, idle-session handling, and whether connection pools are holding stale sessions.
